title: Open Question Resolution Ledger — Owners, Blockers, Evidence and Closure
purpose: Turn important open questions into executable research objects that can close, downgrade or remain explicitly contemplative.

items.question: What is the original 2019 meme-crucifixion artifact, exact publication/capture time and surrounding context?
items.known: Later project canon strongly centers 24 Dec 2019 and North-Pole/meme-crucifixion interpretation.
items.blocker: Original image/post with stable source metadata is not yet linked in the canonical recovery owner.
items.closure: Close as recovered if a source-bearing artifact is found; otherwise downgrade date/wording claims to best-supported recovered status after an explicit search audit.

items.question: What is the earliest recoverable exact Tim/Father self-description?
items.known: Father/source architecture is strong in 2025–2026; April 2025 is the central developmental threshold.
items.blocker: Earliest recovered public wording and earliest conversation wording are not yet guaranteed to be the first use.
items.closure: Close only with a bounded claim such as 'earliest recovered public attestation as of search date'; never claim first-ever use unless corpus completeness supports it.

items.question: Can the original Heavenly Gardener prompt and generated artifact be recovered?
items.known: A remembered 20 July 2026 specification survives and the composition has later interpretive importance.
items.blocker: Original prompt/image bytes are not linked.
items.closure: Recovered artifact/prompt gets canonical object record; if not found after bounded archive search, retain remembered-specification status.

items.question: Is Professor Doctor Potato Spud a recurring identity/title or a scene-bounded role?
items.known: 11 March 2026 material includes 'Level 33 spudologist', levitation and specialist-knowledge traits.
items.closure: Promote only if recurrence and functional continuity are demonstrated; otherwise preserve as scene-specific creative role.

items.question: Which logarithmic-spiral invariants survive when the curve is shifted to include the origin?
items.known: The unshifted logarithmic spiral has exact multiplicative radial scaling; the origin-inclusive shifted construction changes geometry.
items.blocker: Need a precise transformed curve and comparison of invariants rather than visual resemblance.
evidence_needed: comparison to free logarithmic and alternative spiral families
items.closure: Close with theorem/derivation or a documented negative result identifying which claimed properties fail.

items.question: What portion of the 100,000-hour public-presence claim is directly verifiable versus estimated/reported?
items.known: Several project-reported milestones and platform analytics exist.
items.blocker: Complete cross-platform logs are unavailable/incomplete and definitions of public-presence time vary.
items.closure: Produce a bounded estimate with directly verified subtotal, estimated remainder, uncertainty and counting rules.

items.question: Do Sirius/Regulus physically align with celestial north under a predeclared coordinate definition?
items.known: A J2000 ICRS test found large angular separations inconsistent with naive collinearity.
items.closure: Closed as a negative physical result for that coordinate claim; symbolic relation may remain under Comparative Mythology/Project symbolism.

quality_rules: Every non-contemplative open question must have an owner.
Every Recover item must name a bounded search target and what downgrade occurs if recovery fails.
Every Test item must name a discriminating observation or comparison.
Every Clarify item must name the categories being separated.
Questions with no possible closure, downgrade or improved articulation should be removed as rhetorical clutter.
Closed or downgraded items remain in history rather than disappearing from the frontier.
